source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although the boards have been finalized, more changes may arise while you work, and the power board still needs one more change. There is also one small board consisting only of 16 addressable LEDs. Since the scope is larger than I anticipated, I propose accepting the current milestone and opening a new $100 milestone for these two boards plus the LED board. Is that okay?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Perfect. For the LEDs, I think we need to keep a level shifter. The LED board document specifies C2890036 (SK6812 Mini-E, 3228 package), while you shared C5142047 (SK6812SMINI-ER, 2835 package). Which one exactly do you plan to use, so I can update the documents?
